title: NYRR Time Cutoff Policy
claims: The policy took effect starting in January 2024.
The TCS New York City Marathon is listed among the races exempt from the generic policy, with readers directed to the race info page for specific course timelines.
The generic policy closes the finish line at a 20-minute-per-mile pace plus the 20 minutes that the start remains open.
Medical support remains available on the course after the cutoff time, although some course amenities may be removed and breakdown may begin in the finish area.
